# Gerris: AI Search Visibility, AEO, GEO, and SEO

> Gerris is the AI services practice of Gerris Corp, led by Chris Abraham in Arlington, Virginia. Gerris audits how AI answer engines (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini) describe a business, fixes the sources those answers are built from, and measures the result monthly in writing, on a foundation of technical SEO practiced since 1998. Contact: chris@gerriscorp.com, +1 202-352-5051, https://calendly.com/chrisabraham/30 (book a 30-minute call).

- [What is generative engine optimization (GEO)?](https://gerris.ai/guides/what-is-generative-engine-optimization/): How generative AI systems find, understand, verify, and cite a business, and what GEO changes in practice.
- [How do AI answers choose which businesses to name?](https://gerris.ai/guides/how-ai-answers-choose-businesses/): The entity record, the consistency check, and the citability test behind every name an AI answer gives, and the audit that measures them.
